[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] established a new '''trade route''' running between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] and [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] in the [[Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] helped cap Figg's legacy after having previously blazed the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] and [[Nothoiin Corridor]] through the region's formerly impenetrable [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]].

{{Route-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This hyperlane appears, nameless, on the Greater Javin maps appearing in both the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] scenario ''[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' reference book. Only ''Galactic Gazetteer'' refers to this route in any specific terms, identifying it as "the Rimward route to Lutrillia," in relation to the planet Darlyn Boda's intersection point with the Corellian Trade Spine.
